mission: Give a project and its AI coder a shared operating kernel that can configure itself from real work, form useful results and cultivate the competences the project needs.
product_or_result: A repository-first self-installing Project Kernel with deferred situated configuration, one semantic owner, portable competences and continuous reentry.

assertions.text: Direct acquisition defers situated project configuration to the first operator relation.
The maios-project-system competence is the single project-level semantic entry and routes the closest operating competences.
Concrete work and its enabling competence evolve reciprocally through source-bound causal readback.

unknowns: semantic acceptance by a new operator and coder
native behavioral use and maintained reentry on every supported host
